title: Replit Hires Former AWS Public Sector Head Michael Greenwald for New Government Offering
summary:
The AI coding platform launched a dedicated software suite for public servants at all levels of government in the U.S. and abroad. To lead the expansion, Replit hired Michael Greenwald, the former lead of AWS’s public sector business, to help the company transform how public agencies build and operate software. The "Replit for Government" offering allows national, state, local, tribal, and territorial governments to create customized tools using the company's AI.

The push relies on the company's recently introduced Bring Your Own Cloud feature, which allows the platform to be deployed within a customer's own Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS environment. CEO Amjad Masad said the system is designed for high-stakes sectors including finance, healthcare, and government to ensure that sensitive data remains within the user's own security perimeter.
